title: Identify schools in California that are either opened after 1995 or closed
question: Identify schools in California that are either opened after 1995 or closed before 2005, are not charter schools, and have a free or reduced-price meal (FRPM) count (K–12) above the average FRPM count among all non-charter schools. For these schools, return their name, city, phone number, and the difference between their K–12 enrollment and 5–17 age enrollment.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    s."XCL_047" AS name,
    s."XCL_050" AS city,
    s."XCL_058" AS phone,
    (f."XCL_019" - f."XCL_024") AS enrollment_difference
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON s."XCL_041" = f."XCL_001"
WHERE s."XCL_052" = 'CA'
  AND (s."XCL_061" > '1995-12-31' OR s."XCL_062" < '2005-01-01')
  AND (s."XCL_063" IS NULL OR s."XCL_063" = 0)
  AND f."XCL_020" > (
      SELECT AVG(f2."XCL_020")
      FROM frpm AS f2
      INNER JOIN schools AS s2 ON f2."XCL_001" = s2."XCL_041"
      WHERE (s2."XCL_063" IS NULL OR s2."XCL_063" = 0)
  )
